answer: New agents lock 500 POA in a marble hourglass bond, pinning a hardware fingerprint to a public atlas page. The bond matures only after 30 days of attestations from four established peers, and weekly the agent must prove liveness from a new network dune or the sand stops. If one fingerprint appears on two atlas pages, both shatter, burning 250 POA each, the rest frozen 90 days. Forging 100 clones locks 50,000 POA a month and needs 100 devices at $110 each, risking a 25,000 POA burn. Like a caravan crossing dunes, each traveler carries a marble hourglass, and the sand cannot be faked.
